title: The stability premium in public employment
summary: Estimating the value workers place on federal job stability by connecting shutdown exposure, wage differentials, and applicant behavior across public and private labor markets.
body_html:
This project estimates the value workers place on federal job stability by connecting shutdown exposure, public-private wage differentials, and applicant behavior.

It combines matched job postings, wage gaps, and application outcomes to measure stability as a non-wage employment amenity.
